lines.text: A post that's clearly about me?
A post about someone without naming them.
That's a subtweet about our club.

data.mean: A post about someone without naming them.
data.define: A hint-filled post about someone that doesn't use their name.

example.text: That's a subtweet about our club.

misuse.text: Don't send a 'subtweet' about your boss.
misuse.why: People may figure out it's them.
